title: Yaoundé Police Criminelle
description: Lieutenant Samuel Ayissi and Yaoundé's criminal brigade chase justice through the city's underground networks.
synopsis: Set in the heart of Cameroon's capital, "Yaoundé Police Criminelle" follows the high-stakes investigations of Lieutenant Samuel Ayissi and his team. Navigating complex criminal cases, underground networks, and harsh realities on the ground, the criminal brigade fights relentlessly to bring justice to the streets of Yaoundé.

title: One Field
description: Two Tanzanian communities, one annual soccer match, and the reunion that matters more than the score.
synopsis: Every year, the Tanzanian communities of Wichita and Houston meet on a park field in Kansas for one soccer match — and a day of food, old friends and new nations joining in. Two cities. Many nations. One family.

title: Middleton: We Don't Sit and Wait
description: In Jamaica's Blue Mountains, a coffee-farming community rebuilds its only road after Hurricane Melissa.
synopsis: High in Jamaica's Blue Mountains, coffee farmer Paul Miller invites us into Middleton, a community that grows some of the world's most prized coffee. When Hurricane Melissa cut off the only road, the people rebuilt it themselves.

title: Geniuses
description: Over an intimate picnic, two curious minds debate what it truly means to be a genius.
synopsis: Against the serene backdrop of an intimate picnic, GENIUSES follows Kuku and Ribigbe as a seemingly casual conversation develops into a fascinating exploration of exceptional intellect, artistic ingenuity and human creativity. Through engaging exchanges, contrasting perspectives and subtle humour, their discussion explores the mysteries surrounding extraordinary achievements. Blending romance, philosophical reflection and unexpected moments, GENIUSES offers a compelling perspective on intellectual brilliance, human connection and the essence of creativity.
